''See also: [[Thousand-Mile Cloud Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] is a versatile transportation [[construct]] used by [[sacred artists]] for travel and mobility. These objects are composed of densely packed [[cloud madra]] and can vary significantly in appearance, including colors such as red, blue, gold, green, purple, and white. While some are small enough to be carried in cases or summoned from [[void keys]], others are massive enough to serve as foundations for houses, palaces, or entire floating cities. Functionally, these constructs are operated by a core [[script-circle]] that responds to the direction of an individual's spirit, allowing for flexible movement. They require a continuous supply of [[madra]] to remain stable and move; without active maintenance or sufficient power, they can dissipate into mist. While common among civilians for travel, specialized versions are utilized by powerful groups like the [[Skysworn]], who use emerald-colored clouds as symbols of their status. More advanced iterations include cloudships and cloud fortresses, which can support large populations or serve as mobile headquarters for entire sects.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] is a horse-sized, opaque red [[construct]] composed of densely packed [[Forged]] [[cloud madra]] and wisps of essence. Activated by a single [[script-circle]] at its core, this rust-colored object serves as a method of flight that [[Lindon]] can summon and control via a leash of thin [[madra]]. Beyond its use as transportation, the cloud functions as a pack carrier and is an item that can be traded. During its travels, the entity was positioned one week away from the [[Ancestor's Tomb]].}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Originally utilized by [[Jai Daishou]] as a method of flight, the Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] is a deep blue cloud used by [[sacred artists]] to travel through the sky. The [[Skysworn]] once employed these clouds to carry people, and [[Renfei]] even kept one preserved within her armor. While [[Renfei|Pai Ren]] utilizes a personal version for flight, the [[Skysworn]] woman is seen floating upon an emerald-colored cloud. This technique serves as the foundation for [[Sky's Mercy]], and one such cloud was eventually recovered from a [[scripted box]] as a highly valuable possession.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Initially appearing as a green object used by a [[Skysworn]] servant, the Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] is a technique utilized for flight. This golden entity can grow large enough to hold several houses, even bearing a complex of palaces that has hovered outside the [[Akura fortress]]. While [[Lindon]] once saw his own version dissipate into mist, a massive golden cloud was later seen carrying [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] and her retinue within a silk tent. This emerald green presence, which [[Yerin]] could feel, eventually rushed in like a storm's wind over the edge of the island. During this movement, two [[Truegold]] [[dragons]] dropped from the golden cloud.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] is a type of [[green madra]] utilized to power cloudships. While [[Lindon]] previously stored this substance within a box, [[Eithan]] demonstrates its utility by using a deep green variety to float. This [[madra]] can be summoned or dismissed through thought alone, and it is capable of making even an ornate table float. For practical storage, [[Skysworn armor]] features a compartment on the back designed to contain it, allowing the group to carry their supply within their [[emerald armor]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Thousand-Mile [[Cloud]] serves as a versatile flying transport that can function as a base for cloud-rafts. [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] utilized one to travel, while [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] later operated the final remaining flying transport within his clan. During various movements, [[Akura clan]] [[Golds]] have been seen hovering atop these constructs or similar floating platforms. In a moment of conflict, Fingers crashed into [[Lindon]]'s cloud, which [[Yerin]] managed to catch by the edge where the [[madra]] was thinner.
